edges.reason: owner is assigned directly from msg.sender in the constructor.
participated[msg.sender] is set to true based on the caller.
participants.push(msg.sender) adds the caller to the participant list.
winners.push(msg.sender) may add the caller to the winners list.
voters.push(msg.sender) adds the caller to the voter list.
voted[msg.sender] is set to true based on the caller.
disqualify is gated only by msg.sender == referee.
requalify is gated only by msg.sender == referee.
participate rejects callers where msg.sender != tx.origin.
vote rejects callers where msg.sender != tx.origin.
now is compared against deadlineParticipation.
now is compared against deadlineVoting.
Timestamp dependent gate controls execution of participate.
Timestamp dependent gate controls execution of vote.
close may only run when now >= deadlineVoting.
Constructor loop accumulates prize percentages into a uint16 sum, overflowing for large prize tables.
Local sumPrizes is the accumulator of the unchecked prize sum.
participate throws on insufficient value, wrong time window or duplicate participation.
vote throws on insufficient value, wrong time window or duplicate vote.
close invokes determineLuckyVoters before distributing prizes.
close invokes distributePrizes when the balance exceeds the threshold.
External call sends the provider fee to c4c before state is finalized.
External call sends the owner share/remainder to owner.
External call sends the referee share to referee.
External call loops sending prize shares to winners.
External call loops sending the remainder to lucky voters.
Winner addresses stored in winners receive ether via send.
Lucky voter addresses stored in luckyVoters receive ether via send.
c4c address is the destination of the provider fee send.
owner address is the destination of the owner send.
referee address is the destination of the referee send.
randomNumberGen uses block.blockhash as its entropy source.
determineLuckyVoters calls randomNumberGen to pick indices.
nonce parameter selects which past block hash is used.
range parameter bounds the produced random number.
candidate parameter drives all vote bookkeeping.
numVotes[candidate] is incremented.
candidate ranking lives within the bounds of prizeWinners.
candidate may be inserted/repositioned inside the winners array.
vote calls getCandidatePosition when re-ranking.
vote iterates the winners array with index i.
vote shifts winners entries with index j.
candidate parameter is searched inside winners.
startindex parameter sets the scan start.
candidate parameter is the disqualification target.
candidate parameter is the requalification target.
disqualified[candidate] is set to true by the referee.
disqualified[candidate] is cleared by the referee.
determineLuckyVoters loops nLuckyVoters times.
rand local stores the generated index.
nonce local is incremented across attempts.
chosen mapping prevents duplicate lucky voters.
luckyVoters is populated (assigned or pushed).
nLuckyVoters determines how many lucky voters are drawn.
voters array is the pool for lucky voter selection.
distributePrizes computes shares via totalPrize/10000*share.
totalPrize is the base of the prize share arithmetic.
Payout loop over winners uses index i.
Payout loop over luckyVoters uses index j.
amount local holds the per-lucky-voter share.
Predictable blockhash randomness determines the lucky voters.
close checks totalPrize == 0 to detect an already closed contest.
prizeWinners length bounds how many winners are recorded.
participationFee is compared against msg.value.
votingFee is compared against msg.value.
deadlineParticipation gate inside participate.
deadlineVoting gate inside vote.
c4cfee sets the amount sent to c4c.
prizeOwner sets the owner prize share.
prizeReferee sets the referee prize share.
prizeWinners sets each winner prize share.
getTotalVotes returns voters.length.
participate updates the participants array.
Constructor loop index over prizeWinners.
sumPrizes local is validated against 10000 inside the constructor.
vote outer loop index over winners.
vote inner loop index shifting winners.

normalization_plan.reason: vote_candidate is a parameter only meaningful inside vote; fold it into the vote function node.
disqualify_candidate is a parameter consumed solely by disqualify; merge into disqualify.
requalify_candidate is a parameter consumed solely by requalify; merge into requalify.
getCandidatePosition_candidate is a parameter used only by getCandidatePosition; merge into that function.
getCandidatePosition_startindex is a parameter used only by getCandidatePosition; merge into that function.
randomNumberGen_nonce is a parameter consumed only by randomNumberGen; merge into it.
randomNumberGen_range is a parameter consumed only by randomNumberGen; merge into it.
ctor_sumPrizes is the local accumulator of the prize sum arithmetic operation; merge into sum_prizes_arith.
ctor_i is the constructor loop index; merge into the Contest constructor.
vote_i is the vote ranking loop index; merge into vote.
vote_j is the vote array-shift loop index; merge into vote.
determineLuckyVoters_i is the selection loop index; merge into determineLuckyVoters.
determineLuckyVoters_rand is the generated random index; merge into determineLuckyVoters.
determineLuckyVoters_nonce is the local nonce counter; merge into determineLuckyVoters.
determineLuckyVoters_chosen is the local duplicate-guard mapping; merge into determineLuckyVoters.
distributePrizes_i is the winners payout loop index; merge into distributePrizes.
distributePrizes_j is the lucky voter payout loop index; merge into distributePrizes.
distributePrizes_amount is the computed per-voter payout local; merge into distributePrizes.
